source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 4 同主题完形(家庭应急计划/地震记忆/气象收音机/震前防护/洪水救援/为何恐慌)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: A Family Emergency Plan
passages.text: Disasters can strike at any time, so every family should have a (1)____ ready in advance. Sit down together and choose a safe (2)____ where everyone will meet if you are separated. Next, learn the quickest (3)____ out of your home and out of your neighbourhood. It is also important to (4)____ a basic kit with food, water and a torch, and to keep it where it is easy to (5)____. Make sure that everyone knows how to (6)____ off the water, the gas and the electricity. Younger children should (7)____ their parents' phone numbers by heart. Practise the plan two or three (8)____ a year, just like a school fire drill. A good plan will not stop a disaster from (9)____, but it can keep your family much (10)____ when one does.

passages.title: The Morning the Earth Shook
passages.text: I was still asleep when a deep (1)____ woke me before dawn. My bed was shaking so hard that I could not (2)____ up. I heard glass (3)____ as the windows broke one by one. Dust got into my (4)____, and I could not even shout for help. Just then my brother grabbed my arm and (5)____ me towards the door. We reached the street only seconds before the bricks came (6)____ down behind us. When the ground finally became (7)____ again, the silence felt strange and frightening. Around me, weak houses had (8)____ down, and people stood crying in the street. For a long time I was too (9)____ to move at all. Later, I felt thankful that my family was still (10)____ after such a terrible night.

passages.title: The Little Radio That Saves Lives
passages.text: During a big storm, the electricity often goes out, and the television and the internet stop (1)____. Because it runs on (6)____, the radio keeps working even when the power is (7)____. Always keep some (8)____ batteries beside it, so it will never go silent at the worst (9)____. passages.title: Making Your Home Safer
passages.text: You cannot stop an earthquake, but you can make your home much (1)____ before one comes. Walk through every room and look for tall objects that could (2)____ over and hurt someone. Heavy bookcases and cabinets should be fixed firmly to the (3)____. Store heavy or sharp things on (4)____ shelves, not high up where they might fall on your head. Keep dangerous items, such as glass and (5)____ liquids, in low, locked cupboards. Learn where the safe (6)____ in each room are, for example under a strong table. It is also wise to (7)____ a first-aid class, so that you can help if someone is (8)____. Finally, check that everyone in the family knows how to (9)____ off the gas. passages.title: Rescued from the Flood
passages.text: The rain had fallen for three days when the river finally (1)____ its banks. Within an hour, the streets of the small town had turned into (2)____. Outside, the brown water kept (5)____, carrying away cars and furniture. The family felt afraid, but they tried hard to stay (6)____. At last they heard the sound of a (7)____ coming closer through the rain. A rescue team had come in a small one to (8)____ them. One by one, they were helped aboard and taken to (9)____ ground. passages.title: Why People Panic
passages.text: Experts say that the main (1)____ people panic during a disaster is that they do not know what to do. Help the people around you to stay (6)____ too, because fear spreads quickly in a crowd. Never (7)____ towards a lift during an earthquake; always use the stairs. If you are driving, slow down and come to a gentle (8)____. Remember that most disasters (9)____ only a short time.
